select a.id as activity_id, a.title as activity_title, a.recruit_count, ifnull(s.signup_count, 0) as signup_count, ifnull(s.approved_signup_count, 0) as approved_signup_count, ifnull(c.checkin_count, 0) as checkin_count, ifnull(c.checkout_count, 0) as checkout_count, ifnull(r.service_record_count, 0) as service_record_count, ifnull(r.service_minutes, 0) as service_minutes from vol_activity a left join ( select s.activity_id, count(1) as signup_count, sum(case when s.status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as approved_signup_count from vol_activity_signup s left join vol_volunteer_profile p on p.user_id = s.volunteer_user_id
and p.organization like concat('%', #{organization}, '%')
and p.real_name like concat('%', #{volunteerRealName}, '%')
and date(s.create_time) >= #{beginDate} and date(s.create_time) <= #{endDate}
group by s.activity_id ) s on s.activity_id = a.id left join ( select c.activity_id, sum(case when c.checkin_time is not null then 1 else 0 end) as checkin_count, sum(case when c.status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as checkout_count from vol_checkin_record c left join vol_volunteer_profile p on p.user_id = c.volunteer_user_id
and p.organization like concat('%', #{organization}, '%')
and p.real_name like concat('%', #{volunteerRealName}, '%')
and date(c.checkin_time) >= #{beginDate} and date(c.checkin_time) <= #{endDate}
group by c.activity_id ) c on c.activity_id = a.id left join ( select r.activity_id, count(1) as service_record_count, ifnull(sum(r.service_minutes), 0) as service_minutes from vol_service_record r left join vol_volunteer_profile p on p.user_id = r.volunteer_user_id
and r.status = 1
and p.organization like concat('%', #{organization}, '%')
and p.real_name like concat('%', #{volunteerRealName}, '%')
and r.service_date >= #{beginDate} and r.service_date <= #{endDate}
group by r.activity_id ) r on r.activity_id = a.id
and a.id = #{activityId}
and a.title like concat('%', #{activityTitle}, '%')
and date(a.start_time) >= #{beginDate} and date(a.start_time) <= #{endDate}
order by a.start_time desc, a.id desc

select p.user_id as volunteer_user_id, p.real_name, p.phone, p.organization, count(r.id) as service_count, ifnull(sum(r.service_minutes), 0) as service_minutes, max(r.service_date) as latest_service_date from vol_volunteer_profile p left join vol_service_record r on r.volunteer_user_id = p.user_id and r.status = 1 and r.activity_id = #{activityId} and r.service_date >= #{beginDate} and r.service_date <= #{endDate} left join vol_activity a on a.id = r.activity_id
and a.title like concat('%', #{activityTitle}, '%')
and p.organization like concat('%', #{organization}, '%')
and p.real_name like concat('%', #{volunteerRealName}, '%')
group by p.user_id, p.real_name, p.phone, p.organization order by service_minutes desc, service_count desc, p.user_id asc

select ifnull(nullif(p.organization, ''), '未填写') as organization, count(distinct p.user_id) as volunteer_count, count(r.id) as service_count, ifnull(sum(r.service_minutes), 0) as service_minutes, max(r.service_date) as latest_service_date from vol_volunteer_profile p left join vol_service_record r on r.volunteer_user_id = p.user_id and r.status = 1 and r.activity_id = #{activityId} and r.service_date >= #{beginDate} and r.service_date <= #{endDate} left join vol_activity a on a.id = r.activity_id
and a.title like concat('%', #{activityTitle}, '%')
and p.organization like concat('%', #{organization}, '%')
and p.real_name like concat('%', #{volunteerRealName}, '%')
group by ifnull(nullif(p.organization, ''), '未填写') order by service_minutes desc, service_count desc, organization asc

select
date_format(r.service_date, '%Y-%m') date_format(r.service_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as stat_date, count(1) as service_count, ifnull(sum(r.service_minutes), 0) as service_minutes from vol_service_record r left join vol_activity a on a.id = r.activity_id left join vol_volunteer_profile p on p.user_id = r.volunteer_user_id
and r.status = 1 and r.activity_id = #{activityId}
and a.title like concat('%', #{activityTitle}, '%')
and p.organization like concat('%', #{organization}, '%')
and p.real_name like concat('%', #{volunteerRealName}, '%')
and r.service_date >= #{beginDate} and r.service_date <= #{endDate}
group by
date_format(r.service_date, '%Y-%m') date_format(r.service_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
order by stat_date asc
